referentiels.accueil.aucun: No framework yet: nothing is collected. Choose how to start.
referentiels.accueil.catalogue_milieu: brings together all KPIs: {nombre}, of which
referentiels.apercu.absents_aide: These KPIs are in “{existant}” but not in the file. By default, they stay there.
referentiels.apercu.aucune_difference: No difference: the installed framework is identical to the file.

referentiels.apercu.inchanges_catalogue.one: {n} KPI unchanged or already in the catalogue identically (reused)
referentiels.apercu.inchanges_catalogue.other: {n} KPIs unchanged or already in the catalogue identically (reused)

referentiels.apercu.kpi_compte: {fichier} in the file · {referentiel} in the framework
referentiels.apercu.niveaux_autres: The file uses other levels ({liste}). The tool attaches the KPIs concerned automatically: entered KPIs at the lowest level of your tree, parameters at the highest, and calculated KPIs at the level of their sources.
referentiels.apercu.niveaux_repris: Entry levels taken from the file: {liste}.
referentiels.apercu.pied_aide: After changing a choice (code, level, conflict), update the preview to see its effects (formulas, rules).
referentiels.apercu.relier: Link the levels of the file yourself…
referentiels.apercu.relier_aide: After a change, click “Update the preview”. You can also change the level of each KPI after the import, in its sheet, or for several KPIs at once in the content of the framework.

referentiels.apercu.resultat.langues.one: {n} language added (inactive). To use it, make it active in Settings › Languages.
referentiels.apercu.resultat.langues.other: {n} languages added (inactive). To use them, make them active in Settings › Languages.

referentiels.apercu.retirer_aide: (they stay in the catalogue, with their values)

referentiels.apercu.rejets_non_importes.one: {n} KPI rejected: the import leaves it out and imports the rest. To import it too, correct the file, then import it again.
referentiels.apercu.rejets_non_importes.other: {n} KPIs rejected: the import leaves them out and imports the rest. To import them too, correct the file, then import it again.

referentiels.apercu.version_ancienne: This version is older than the installed version ({installee}). Check the differences before you apply it.
referentiels.catalogue.hors_aide: These KPIs are in no framework, so they are not collected, unless a collected KPI uses them in its formula. To add them, open the content of a framework and click “Add from…”.
referentiels.catalogue.ouvrir_fiche: Click a KPI to open its sheet.
referentiels.catalogue.preuve_obligatoir: Evidence required: the value cannot be validated without evidence
referentiels.catalogue.ranger: To arrange, add or remove KPIs:
referentiels.catalogue.recherche: Search by ID, name or formula
referentiels.catalogue.une_fois: Each KPI appears once, placed according to the first framework that contains it.
referentiels.catalogue.utilisations_titr: Calculated KPIs whose formula includes it
referentiels.composition.copie_soi: A theme cannot be copied into itself.
referentiels.config.boucle: Loop: a theme cannot be placed under itself.
referentiels.config.campagnes_existent: This framework has campaigns, so its frequency and reporting year start cannot change. For another frequency, create another framework.
referentiels.config.code_deux_fois_ref: Code appears twice in this framework (row {ligne}).
referentiels.config.code_trop_long: Code too long (40 characters at most).
referentiels.config.couleur_format: The colour must be in #RRGGBB format.
referentiels.config.kpi_deux_fois: KPI appears twice in this framework (row {ligne}).
referentiels.config.mois_debut: Month the reporting year starts: from 1 (January) to 12.
referentiels.config.parent_inconnu: Unknown parent theme in this framework: “{theme}”.
referentiels.config.theme_inconnu: Unknown theme in this framework: “{theme}” (code from the Themes sheet).
referentiels.contenu.kpi.facultatif_titr: Not counted in the completion rate or in reminders. Contributors can still enter a value.
referentiels.contenu.kpi.ligne_aria: {nom}: open the sheet (Enter), arrange (Alt + up or down arrow)
referentiels.contenu.kpi.retirer_titre: Remove from this framework (the KPI stays in the catalogue)
referentiels.contenu.lot.niveau_aria: Entry level of the selected KPIs
referentiels.contenu.lot.retirer_confirm: Remove the selected KPIs from this framework? They stay in the catalogue, with their values.
referentiels.contenu.recherche_placehold: Search for a KPI or a theme
referentiels.contenu.regler_niveaux: Set the entry levels: the tool attached each KPI to your tree (entered KPIs at the lowest level, inherited parameters at the highest, calculated KPIs at the level of their sources). To change several KPIs at once, select them, then choose “Entry level” in the bar that appears. To change one KPI, open its sheet.
referentiels.contenu.theme.vide: Empty. Drag a KPI or a theme here, or click “+ KPI”.
referentiels.contenu.tiroir_aide: Drag an entire theme or a KPI into a theme on the left, or click “+”. KPIs are not copied: each KPI has one value, whatever the number of frameworks.
referentiels.contenu.vide: Empty framework. Click “+ Theme” to create its themes, or “New KPI”. To bring in themes and KPIs from other frameworks, library templates, or the catalogue, click “Add from…”.
referentiels.copie.explication: The copy takes the themes and the KPIs, with their theme, label, order, and required status. It also takes the frequency, the reporting year, the comparison, the colour, and the translations. The KPIs stay those of the catalogue: a value counts in both frameworks, and nobody enters it twice. The campaigns stay with the original, except those that you move to the copy.
referentiels.copie.code_aide: If you leave it empty, the tool takes it from the name. You cannot change it afterwards, because files use it.
referentiels.copie.desactiver_aide: Use this for a new version. The original disappears from the filters and is no longer collected. Its campaigns and values are kept.
referentiels.actif.confirmer_desactiver: Make “{referentiel}” inactive? It disappears from the filters and is no longer collected. Its campaigns, values, and content are kept, and you can reactivate it in one click.
referentiels.vues.desactive: “{nom}” is inactive: it no longer appears in the filters. Its campaigns and values are kept.
referentiels.installer.choisir_d_abord: First choose the KPIs to install.
referentiels.installer.cocher_un_ajouter: Select at least one KPI to add.
referentiels.installer.kpi.cocher_un_ajo: Select at least one KPI to add

referentiels.installer.kpi.deja_installe.one: “{existant}” is already installed: its KPI stays as it is. Select the KPIs that you want to add. Nothing is removed.
referentiels.installer.kpi.deja_installe.other: “{existant}” is already installed: its {n} KPIs stay as they are. Select the KPIs that you want to add. Nothing is removed.

referentiels.installer.kpi.dont_existant: of which {nombre} already in the tool

referentiels.installer.kpi.nouvelle_vers.one: New version {version} of “{existant}” (version {installee} installed). The KPI already in the framework stays selected. The KPIs that you left out stay deselected: select the ones that you want to add.
referentiels.installer.kpi.nouvelle_vers.other: New version {version} of “{existant}” (version {installee} installed). The {n} KPIs already in the framework stay selected. The KPIs that you left out stay deselected: select the ones that you want to add.

referentiels.installer.kpi.tous_presents: All the KPIs of this template are already in “{existant}”: nothing to add.
referentiels.installer.kpi.tout_coche: All KPIs are selected. Deselect the ones that you do not need. A KPI used to calculate a selected KPI is added anyway.
referentiels.installer.modeles.chapeau: Choose a template, then select the KPIs that you want on the next screen. The tool installs their definitions, units, and formulas, and attaches them to your tree.
referentiels.installer.modeles.excel_tit: To read it or adapt it before importing it
referentiels.documents.chapeau: The documents this template is built from. The document date is the one written in the document; when the document gives no exact date, only the year is shown.

referentiels.installer.resume.ajout.one: {n} KPI will be added to “{existant}”. Nothing is removed.
referentiels.installer.resume.ajout.other: {n} KPIs will be added to “{existant}”. Nothing is removed.

referentiels.installer.resume.ajout_vers.one: {n} KPI will be added to “{existant}”, updated to version {version}. Nothing is removed.
referentiels.installer.resume.ajout_vers.other: {n} KPIs will be added to “{existant}”, updated to version {version}. Nothing is removed.

referentiels.installer.resume.ajoutes_au.one: {n} KPI added automatically because a formula uses it:
referentiels.installer.resume.ajoutes_au.other: {n} KPIs added automatically because a formula uses them:

referentiels.installer.resume.arbre_libr: Your tree has no organisation yet. Its levels are {niveaux}. If you need other levels (for example Holding › Subsidiary),
referentiels.installer.resume.arbre_suit: : it is simpler before the installation.
referentiels.installer.resume.conflits_a: Same code as a KPI of the tool, but a different definition: by default, the tool's KPI is reused.

referentiels.installer.resume.installes.one: {n} KPI will be installed in the new framework “{nom}”, arranged in {themes}.
referentiels.installer.resume.installes.other: {n} KPIs will be installed in the new framework “{nom}”, arranged in {themes}.

referentiels.installer.resume.niveau_cal: calculated KPIs at the level of their sources
referentiels.installer.resume.niveau_par: inherited parameters, such as emission factors, at level {niveau} (the highest, a single value carried down)
referentiels.installer.resume.niveau_sai: entered KPIs at the levels advised by the template ({niveaux})
referentiels.installer.resume.niveaux_ch: You can change the level of each KPI in its sheet, or of several at once in the content of the framework.
referentiels.installer.resume.niveaux_ga: KPIs already in the tool keep their entry level.

referentiels.installer.resume.reutilises.one: Reused: {n} KPI already in the tool (entered once, at its current entry level).
referentiels.installer.resume.reutilises.other: Reused: {n} KPIs already in the tool (entered once, at their current entry level).

referentiels.installer.resume.un_niveau: Attachment in your tree: your tree has only one level, so all KPIs are entered at level {niveau}.
referentiels.installer.resume.voir_detai: See the details (codes already in use, units created, rules)
referentiels.js.ajoute_quand_meme: Will be added anyway: used by {liste}

referentiels.js.ajoutes_annonce.one: {n} KPI not selected but added anyway: a formula uses it.
referentiels.js.ajoutes_annonce.other: {n} KPIs not selected but added anyway: a formula uses them.

referentiels.js.dont_existants: of which {nombre} already in the tool
referentiels.mep.apercu_pour_moi: Data entry › Everything assigned to me
referentiels.mep.arbre.decale: Row {ligne}: “{nom}” is indented with no organisation above it.
referentiels.mep.arbre.deux_fois: Row {ligne}: “{nom}” appears twice in different places.
referentiels.mep.arbre.existe_ailleurs: Row {ligne}: “{nom}” already exists elsewhere in the tree ({niveau}).
referentiels.mep.arbre.date_invalide: Row {ligne}: “{nom}”: the opening date does not exist. Write it as 2026-03-01 or 01/03/2026.
referentiels.mep.arbre.niveau_plus_bas: Row {ligne}: “{nom}” ({niveau}) must be at a lower level than “{parent}” ({niveau_parent}).
referentiels.mep.arbre.rattacher: Row {ligne}: “{nom}” ({niveau}) must be attached to an organisation of a higher level.

referentiels.mep.arbre.trop_bas.one: Row {ligne}: “{nom}” is too deep: only {n} level.
referentiels.mep.arbre.trop_bas.other: Row {ligne}: “{nom}” is too deep: only {n} levels.

referentiels.mep.arbre.trop_de_lignes: The list has {n} organisations. Paste at most {maximum} at a time: split the list.
referentiels.mep.arbre.limite_aide: At most {maximum} rows at a time. For a longer list, paste it in several parts, or use the configuration file.
referentiels.mep.cadre.huit_etapes: 8 steps. You can stop and continue later.
referentiels.mep.cadre.terminee_aide: Completed: click a step to review it.
referentiels.mep.campagne.apercu_equipe: The administrator follows progress on the dashboard, sends reminders, reviews the values (review stage), and then closes the campaign.
referentiels.mep.campagne.apercu_fin: “data entry ends on {date}”. After this date, contributors can only read.
referentiels.mep.campagne.apercu_haut: At the top of each page
referentiels.mep.campagne.aucun_referent: No active framework. Go back to step 5 to install or create one, or finish without a campaign and create it later in Administration › Campaigns.
referentiels.mep.campagne.intro: Choose the period to collect and the data entry dates. The tool suggests the current period. You can open data entry now or keep the campaign in preparation.
referentiels.mep.campagne.ouvrir_mainten: Open data entry now (otherwise: in preparation)
referentiels.mep.compte.apercu_aide: Everyone signs in with their email. You create the team's accounts at step 7. Each person receives a temporary password and replaces it at first sign-in.
referentiels.mep.compte.form.email_inval: This email address is not valid. Enter an address such as first.last@example.com.
referentiels.mep.compte.form.mdp_differe: The two passwords are different. Enter the same password twice.
referentiels.mep.compte.intro: Welcome. This installation is empty: start with your administrator account. With it, you set up the tool, create the team's accounts, and open campaigns.
referentiels.mep.compte.mdp_aide: At least 8 characters, not only digits, different from your name or email.
referentiels.mep.deja_terminee: The setup is complete. You now change all settings in Administration.
referentiels.mep.equipe.apercu_pour_moi_: Then, the “Data entry” tab (“Everything assigned to me” view) lists everything assigned to them, organisation by organisation.
referentiels.mep.equipe.apercu_premiere_: The person signs in with their email and the temporary password. “My account” then opens, so that they choose their own password.
referentiels.mep.equipe.intro: Create the team's accounts (optional for now). Each person receives a temporary password: send it with the suggested message. They choose their own password at first sign-in. Then set the assignments (who enters what) in the grid.
referentiels.mep.etape.campagne.resume: Period, dates, opening of data entry.
referentiels.mep.etape.compte.resume: Your account, which sets up everything else.
referentiels.mep.etape.fiche.ensuite: Administration › Frameworks and KPIs › Units and formats
referentiels.mep.etape.organisation.ensu: Administration › Settings › Levels of the tree and Administration › Organisations
referentiels.mep.etape.organisation.resu: Levels of the tree and organisations.
referentiels.mep.etape.referentiels.resu: Add a framework: the KPIs to collect.
referentiels.mep.etape.structure.resume: Name, logo and colours of the tool.
referentiels.mep.etape_passee: Step skipped: the default values are kept.
referentiels.mep.fiche.ajouter_aide: Add a unit, an answer type (yes / no, choice list), a category or a field:
referentiels.mep.fiche.ajouter_suite: , then come back here through the banner.
referentiels.mep.fiche.apercu_aide: The contributor sees only the “shown” categories. Only the administrator sees the others.
referentiels.mep.fiche.intro: The sheet of each KPI holds its definition (split into categories), its unit, its entry type (entered, calculated, inherited parameter), its answer type, and your own fields. A default set is ready, and the installed templates added what they need.

referentiels.mep.import_fait.one: “{referentiel}” imported: {n} KPI placed. You can adjust it later in Administration › Frameworks and KPIs.
referentiels.mep.import_fait.other: “{referentiel}” imported: {n} KPIs placed. You can adjust it later in Administration › Frameworks and KPIs.

referentiels.mep.langues.apercu_aide: Menus are available in several languages. The names of KPIs, themes, and definitions follow the chosen language, or the default language when there is no translation.
referentiels.mep.langues.intro: The languages into which you can translate KPIs, themes, and definitions. Each person chooses their language in “My account”. Otherwise, they see the default language. The texts entered are in {reference} (reference language).
referentiels.mep.niveaux.a_confirmer: First confirm the levels of the tree (“Confirm these levels” button): organisations and KPIs are attached to them.
referentiels.mep.niveaux.enregistres: Levels of the tree saved and confirmed.
referentiels.mep.niveaux.noms: Each level has a name, different from the others.
referentiels.mep.niveaux.utilises: Organisations or KPIs already use the levels: change them in Administration › Settings › Levels of the tree.
referentiels.mep.organisation.a_confirme: Choose the levels, then confirm them. You can go to the next step only after you confirm the levels.
referentiels.mep.organisation.apercu_aid: Each contributor sees only the organisations assigned to them. A validator sees the organisations in their scope.
referentiels.mep.organisation.figes: Organisations or KPIs already use these levels: rename them, add some or reorder them in
referentiels.mep.organisation.intro: First set the levels of the tree (from the top down), then the organisations. Each KPI is entered at one level (for example electricity per site, headcount per entity) and added up towards the top.
referentiels.mep.organisation.niveaux_ai: One level per line, from the top down, 8 at most. Write “Name; Plural” if the plural is not the name plus “s”.
referentiels.mep.organisation.niveaux_ex:
Group ; Groups
Region ; Regions
Branch ; Branches
referentiels.mep.organisation.saisie_rap: Quick entry: one organisation per line, indented under its parent organisation (the indentation gives the level). “Name [{niveau}]” forces the level, even when a level in between is missing: the organisation then sits directly under the top organisation. You can also paste from Excel a table with one column per level ({niveaux}), or import the
referentiels.mep.organisation.date_ouver: “Name [2026-03-01]” gives the opening date of a new organisation: it counts only from that date. You can write it with the level: “Name [{niveau}, 2026-03-01]”.
referentiels.mep.organisation_requise: Enter at least one organisation, or click “Skip” to do it later.
referentiels.mep.referentiel_requis: Add at least one framework, or click “Skip” to do it later.
referentiels.mep.referentiels.apercu_aid: KPIs are shown in the Data entry page, arranged by theme, with their definition.
referentiels.mep.referentiels.apercu_vid: The themes of the first framework will appear here.
referentiels.mep.referentiels.aucun: No framework yet: install one or create one above.
referentiels.mep.referentiels.frequence_: Frequency: one campaign per year, half-year, quarter, or month. It cannot change after the first campaign.
referentiels.mep.referentiels.intro: A framework is a set of KPIs arranged in themes. Choose how to start. You can change everything afterwards, and a KPI that is in several frameworks is entered only once.
referentiels.mep.retour_compo: Framework created from the setup. Add its KPIs with “Add from…”, then go back to the setup.
referentiels.mep.structure.intro: The name of your organisation and of the tool, the logo and the colours: they apply to all pages and to Excel files. The preview updates as you choose.
referentiels.mep.terminee: Setup complete. You can still change everything in Administration.
referentiels.nouveau.chapeau: A framework is a set of KPIs arranged in themes. Choose how to start. You can change everything afterwards, and a KPI that is in several frameworks is entered only once.
referentiels.paquets.aucun_niveau: The installation has no level of the tree. Create the levels in Settings › Levels of the tree.
referentiels.paquets.campagnes_gardee: {champ}: “{valeur}” in the file, but “{referentiel}” already has campaigns: the current value is kept.
referentiels.paquets.choisir_referentiel: First choose the framework to compose.
referentiels.paquets.unite_casse_reprise: The unit “{texte}” of the file is read as the unit “{symbole}” of this installation: only the case is different. Make sure that it is the same unit before you import.
referentiels.paquets.unite_casse_creee: The unit “{texte}” of the file is created as a new unit. This installation has the unit “{symbole}”, but in a symbol the case can change the unit (m milli, M mega).
referentiels.paquets.classeur_config: This file is a configuration workbook (“Frameworks” sheet): import it in Administration › Configuration files (Edit in bulk), or export the framework as a framework file.
referentiels.paquets.code_deux_fois: Code appears twice in the file (with “{code}”).
referentiels.paquets.code_existe: The code “{code}” already exists: choose another one.
referentiels.paquets.code_manque: The framework code is missing (Framework sheet, “Code” row).

referentiels.paquets.crees_catalogue.one: {n} created in the catalogue (with the sources of the formulas)
referentiels.paquets.crees_catalogue.other: {n} created in the catalogue (with the sources of the formulas)

referentiels.paquets.expire: The file has expired. Import it again.
referentiels.paquets.formats: Accepted formats: Excel (.xlsx) or JSON file.
referentiels.paquets.frequence_inconnue: Unknown frequency: the tool uses the annual frequency.
referentiels.paquets.glisser: Drag a theme or a KPI.
referentiels.paquets.illisible: Unreadable framework file: the “referentiel” part is missing. Start again from a file exported by the tool.
referentiels.paquets.contenu_inattendu: Unreadable framework file: the “{champ}” part does not have the expected form, for example after a change by hand. Start again from a file exported by the tool.
referentiels.paquets.contenu_illisible: Unreadable framework file: part of the content does not have the expected form, for example after a change by hand. Start again from a file exported by the tool.
referentiels.paquets.kpi_retire: {code} removed from “{referentiel}” (it stays in the catalogue).
referentiels.paquets.meme_code_casse: Same code, apart from case, as “{code}”.
referentiels.paquets.mois_hors: Month the reporting year starts outside 1 to 12: January used.
referentiels.paquets.nom_manque: The framework name is missing (Framework sheet, “Name” row).
referentiels.paquets.nouveau_code_existe: The new code “{code}” already exists: choose another one.
referentiels.paquets.pas_recopies: KPIs are not copied: a single value is entered.
referentiels.paquets.pas_un_fichier: This file is not a framework file: the “Framework” sheet is missing. To see the format, download the “existing system” template.
referentiels.paquets.regle_existe: A rule with the same name already exists.
referentiels.paquets.regle_parties: Both parts of the rule are required.
referentiels.paquets.theme_boucle: Theme “{theme}”: parent loop, placed at the top.
referentiels.paquets.theme_code_long: Theme “{theme}”: code too long (40 characters at most), ignored.
referentiels.paquets.theme_code_manquant: Theme “{theme}”: code missing or appearing twice, ignored.
referentiels.paquets.theme_parent_inconn: Theme “{theme}”: unknown parent “{parent}”, placed at the top.
referentiels.paquets.trop_gros: This file is larger than {taille} MB. Select a smaller file.
referentiels.paquets.type_reponse_change: The answer type would change from “{avant}” to “{apres}”: the KPI already has answers.

referentiels.paquets.unite_change.one: The unit would change from “{avant}” to “{apres}”: the KPI already has {n} value. The KPI stays as it is.
referentiels.paquets.unite_change.other: The unit would change from “{avant}” to “{apres}”: the KPI already has {n} values. The KPI stays as it is.

referentiels.partage.a_jour: Installed from “{nom}”, version {version}: up to date.
referentiels.partage.ajouter_autres: Add other KPIs from the template…
referentiels.partage.aucune_modification: No change in the history yet.
referentiels.partage.exporter_aide: A file with the framework, its themes, its KPIs (translations, definitions, formulas, and their sources), and the units, types, categories, fields, and consistency rules that they use. Use it to give the framework to another installation, to keep a version, or to edit it and import it again here. Version exported: {version} (change it in Settings).
referentiels.partage.importer_aide: A file of this framework, exported here or elsewhere, then edited. The tool recognises it by its identifier. The preview shows the KPIs added, changed, and absent. Nothing is saved before you confirm, and nothing is deleted.
referentiels.partage.maj_aide: KPIs already in the framework stay selected. The KPIs of the new version that you do not have are not selected. Nothing is added or removed without your agreement.
referentiels.portes.bibliotheque.aide: Ready-to-use templates, such as the Voluntary Standard VS. Select the KPIs that you want, and the tool installs their definitions, units, and formulas.
referentiels.portes.composer.aide: Create a framework (for example a dashboard or a report) and bring in KPIs that already exist: from your frameworks, the catalogue, or the templates. No KPI is copied.
referentiels.portes.importer.aide: A file exported from another installation (Excel or JSON), or your existing system described in the Excel template. Before anything is saved, a preview shows what the import creates.
referentiels.portes.importer.choisir: Choose a file or drag it here
referentiels.portes.importer.modele_titr: One row per KPI: ID, name, theme, unit, answer type, granularity, aggregation, and definition. Only the ID and the name are required.
referentiels.reglable.apercu.entier: Whole number: a value with decimals is reported in Consistency.
referentiels.reglable.apercu.legende: * required to save the sheet. “internal”: never shown to the contributor.
referentiels.reglable.code_aide: The code does not change: imported files and KPIs stay linked to it.
referentiels.reglable.code_fixe: Fixed code, used in import files
referentiels.reglable.reponse.fin_debut: “Values (list)” is only for the choice list. Whole number, euros, kWh…: the
referentiels.reglable.reponse.fin_suite: of the KPI sets this (“Whole” box, units €, k€, M€…), not the answer type.
referentiels.reglable.reponse.liste_exem: For example: level of certification (None, In progress, Certified).
referentiels.reglable.reponse.liste_text: One answer among fixed values. Enter the values in “Values (list)”, one per line. Counted like yes / no.
referentiels.reglable.reponse.nombre_tex: A quantity, shown with the unit of the KPI. It is added up and used in formulas.
referentiels.reglable.reponse.oui_non_ex: For example: is the site ISO 14001 certified?
referentiels.reglable.reponse.oui_non_te: Two buttons. At higher levels, the tool counts the answers (“Yes: 3 · No: 1”). Not used in formulas.
referentiels.reglable.reponse.pct_exempl: For example: share of women in management.
referentiels.reglable.reponse.pct_texte: The contributor enters 35 and sees “35%” (between 0 and 100). For a share or a rate.
referentiels.reglable.saisie.calcul_exem: For example: emissions = electricity × emission factor, share of women = women ÷ headcount.
referentiels.reglable.saisie.calcul_text: Nobody enters anything: the tool calculates the value from other KPIs, using the formula of the KPI sheet.
referentiels.reglable.saisie.herite_exem: For example: emission factor of electricity in France (0,052 kgCO2eq/kWh), entered for “France” and used automatically by each French site in its calculations.
referentiels.reglable.saisie.herite_text: A value entered only once, at the top of the tree (group or country). All the organisations attached below take it as it is, without entering it again or adding it up.
referentiels.reglable.saisie.libre: The label, tag, and colour are free (for example an “Estimated” type that behaves like an entry). The behaviour controls the calculation and cannot change after the type is in use.
referentiels.reglable.saisie.saisie_exem: For example: electricity consumed by the Lyon site. The country and group totals are added up automatically.
referentiels.reglable.saisie.saisie_text: The contributor enters the value in the Data entry page, for their organisation.
referentiels.reglable.seule_liste: Only a choice list has values
referentiels.reglable.supprimer_impossib: In use: only an unused item can be deleted
referentiels.reglable.traductions_aide: Texts in the reference language. Translations:
referentiels.reglable.valeurs_exemple:
One value per line, for example:
None
In progress
referentiels.reglable.valeurs_exemple_aj:
One value per line, for example:
None
In progress
Certified
referentiels.reglages.actif_aide: Turn off to stop collecting it. It disappears from the filters, and its history is kept.
referentiels.reglages.campagnes_existent: This framework has campaigns, so its frequency and reporting year start cannot change. For another frequency, create another framework.
referentiels.reglages.code_fin: (fixed, used in files). Translations of the name: Settings › Languages › Translations.
referentiels.reglages.collecte_aide: One campaign per period. If another framework collects a KPI more often (for example every month), its value comes here automatically (sum, average, or last value, as set in the KPI sheet). The variance shown at data entry and the consistency checks compare with the same period last year or with the previous period.
referentiels.reglages.couleur_aide: Badge of the framework in filters and tables.
referentiels.reglages.suppression_imposs: Only an empty framework with no campaign can be deleted. To stop collecting it, make it inactive.
referentiels.reglages.supprimer_confirme: Delete the framework “{referentiel}” and its themes?
referentiels.reglages.sur_total: {position} of {total}: order of the filters and lists.
referentiels.reglages.version_aide: Increase it before you export a new version (for example 1.1 or 2026.1).
referentiels.reglages.date_version_aide: Set to today when you change the version, unless you change it yourself.
referentiels.socle.socle_energie.descrip: Site energy consumption by source, renewable share, energy intensity.
referentiels.socle.socle_esrs.descriptio: Selection of quantitative ESRS metrics (E1, E3, E5, S1, G1), grouped by disclosure requirement, with the data used to calculate them. Qualitative information and the double materiality assessment are not covered.
referentiels.socle.socle_ges.description: Emissions following the GHG Protocol: scopes 1 and 2 calculated from consumption and emission factors, scope 3 entered by category (results of a carbon footprint), carbon intensity.
referentiels.socle.socle_social.descript: Workforce, turnover, training, health and safety, diversity and equality.
referentiels.socle.vs_base.nom: Voluntary Standard VS (formerly VSME) – Basic Module
referentiels.socle.vs_base.description: Disclosures B1 to B11 of the European Voluntary Standard (Delegated Regulation 2026/1560, which replaces the VSME), for companies with up to 1,000 employees; exports to EFRAG's official workbook (Digital Template 2.0.0). B3, B6 and B7 are voluntary for companies with 10 employees or less (answer N/A).
referentiels.socle.vs_complet.nom: Voluntary Standard VS (formerly VSME) – Comprehensive Module
referentiels.socle.vs_complet.descriptio: Disclosures C1 to C9 of the European Voluntary Standard, added to the Basic Module (option B of EFRAG's official workbook): strategy, climate targets, climate risks, workforce, human rights, sensitive revenues, gender diversity. C1, C3, C4, the turnover rate (C5), C6 and C7 are largely voluntary for companies with 10 employees or less (answer N/A).
referentiels.socle.transparence_remu.nom: Pay transparency – gender pay gap reporting
referentiels.socle.transparence_remu.des: Gender pay gap reporting required by the European directive 2023/970, one report per employer (entered at entity level): mean and median gaps, variable pay, quartiles, gaps by category, joint pay assessment and transparency obligations. Mean gaps are recalculated for the group from the totals; medians and quartiles stay specific to each entity.
referentiels.socle.esrs_2.description: General disclosures of the revised ESRS 2: basis for preparation, governance, strategy, materiality assessment, and the general requirements on policies, actions, metrics and targets of entity-specific matters. Install it with the templates of the material topics. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_e1.description: Revised ESRS E1: transition plan, climate risks, policies, actions and targets, energy, scope 1, 2 and 3 greenhouse gas emissions, removals and carbon credits, internal carbon pricing, anticipated financial effects. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_e2.description: Revised ESRS E2: policies, actions and targets on pollution, emissions of pollutants to air, water and soil, microplastics, substances of concern and of very high concern. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_e3.description: Revised ESRS E3: policies, actions and targets on water, water consumption, withdrawal, discharge, recycling and storage. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_e4.description: Revised ESRS E4: biodiversity transition plan, policies, actions and targets, offsets, sites linked to sensitive areas and metrics. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_e5.nom: ESRS E5 – Resource use and circular economy
referentiels.socle.esrs_e5.description: Revised ESRS E5: policies, actions and targets on resource use and circular economy, resource inflows, durability and recyclability of products, waste by treatment. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_s1.description: Revised ESRS S1: policies, engagement, actions and targets on the own workforce, headcount, non-employees, collective bargaining, gender diversity of top management, adequate wages, social protection, disability, training, health and safety, family leave, remuneration, incidents. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_s2.nom: ESRS S2 – Workers in the value chain
referentiels.socle.esrs_s2.description: Revised ESRS S2: policies, engagement, grievance mechanisms, actions, incidents and targets on workers in the value chain. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_s3.description: Revised ESRS S3: policies, engagement (indigenous peoples included), grievance mechanisms, actions, incidents and targets on affected communities. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_s4.description: Revised ESRS S4: policies, engagement, grievance mechanisms, actions, incidents and targets on consumers and end-users. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.socle.esrs_g1.description: Revised ESRS G1: anti-corruption and whistle-blower policies, supplier relationships, convictions and fines, political influence, payment practices. Install it if the topic is material, with the ESRS 2 template. Built from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563 of 3 July 2026.
referentiels.sources.glisser_theme: Drag the theme “{theme}” and its sub-themes
referentiels.sources.tous_classes: All the KPIs of the catalogue are in at least one framework.

referentiels.vues.a_des_campagnes_freque: “{referentiel}” already has campaigns, so its frequency and reporting year start cannot change. For another frequency, create another framework.
referentiels.vues.cocher_catalogue: Select or enter at least one KPI from the catalogue.
referentiels.vues.cocher_referentiel: Select at least one KPI of the framework.
referentiels.vues.contient_kpi: “{referentiel}” contains KPIs: make it inactive instead, or remove its KPIs first.
referentiels.vues.cree: Framework “{nom}” created: add its themes and KPIs.

referentiels.vues.kpi_retires.one: {n} KPI removed from “{referentiel}”: it stays in the catalogue.
referentiels.vues.kpi_retires.other: {n} KPIs removed from “{referentiel}”: they stay in the catalogue.

referentiels.vues.niveau_avertissement: {calcule} is calculated at level {niveau_calcule} but {source} is entered at level {niveau_source}: {calcule} has no value at level {niveau_calcule}.

referentiels.vues.niveau_confirmer.one: {n} answer entered in {campagnes}. Values already entered at another level are then no longer counted. Confirm?
referentiels.vues.niveau_confirmer.other: {n} answers entered in {campagnes}. Values already entered at another level are then no longer counted. Confirm?

referentiels.vues.niveau_deja.one: This KPI is already entered at level {niveau}.
referentiels.vues.niveau_deja.other: These KPIs are already entered at level {niveau}.

referentiels.vues.nom_obligatoire: The name of the framework is required.
referentiels.vues.theme_code_existe: The theme code “{code}” already exists in this framework.
referentiels.vues.theme_dans_lui_meme: “{theme}” cannot be placed in itself or in one of its sub-themes.
referentiels.vues.theme_nom_obligatoire: The name of the theme is required.
referentiels.vues.theme_pas_vide: “{theme}” is not empty: first move its KPIs and sub-themes.
referentiels.vues.theme_pas_vide_retirer: “{theme}” is not empty: first move or remove its KPIs and sub-themes.
referentiels.vues.theme_sous_lui_meme: “{nom}” cannot be placed under itself or under one of its sub-themes.
referentiels.reglable.reponse.texte_text: A free answer with formatting (bold, headings, lists, links) and a preview, 20,000 characters at most. Never used in a calculation or an aggregation. Lists show an extract, and exports show the full text.
referentiels.reglable.reponse.texte_exem: For example: describe the responsible purchasing policy.
referentiels.reglable.apercu.texte_exemp:
**Policy** in place since 2024:
- charter signed
- annual audits
referentiels.copie.campagnes: Move to the copy the campaigns from reporting year
referentiels.copie.campagnes_aide: For example, with 2026, the 2026 campaign and later ones go to the copy. Earlier years stay with the original (historical framework). Values do not move. Campaigns of the original: {liste}.
referentiels.copie.exercice_invalide: This reporting year is not valid. Enter a year, for example 2026.

referentiels.liste.absents.one: {n} listed code is not in this framework (ignored): {liste}
referentiels.liste.absents.other: {n} listed codes are not in this framework (ignored): {liste}

referentiels.liste.codes_aide: One per line, or separated by spaces, commas or semicolons.
referentiels.liste.explication: Paste KPI codes, for example a column copied from Excel. A removed KPI stays in the catalogue with its values, and in the other frameworks. You can put it back in this framework at any time. Nothing is removed before you confirm.
referentiels.liste.mode_garder: Keep only the listed KPIs (remove all the others)
referentiels.liste.que_faire: What to do with the list?
referentiels.liste.titre: Remove KPIs from “{referentiel}” using a list
referentiels.liste.vide: Paste at least one KPI code.
referentiels.contenu.aide_titre: How do I arrange the KPIs?
referentiels.contenu.aide_glisser: Drag the handle of a KPI or a theme to arrange it.
referentiels.contenu.aide_clavier: With the keyboard, press Alt + up or down arrow on a KPI.
referentiels.contenu.astuce_clavier: Keyboard: select a KPI row, then press Alt + ↑ or Alt + ↓ to move it within its theme.
referentiels.contenu.aide_tactile: On a phone or tablet, use the arrows of a KPI, or the actions menu of a theme.
referentiels.contenu.aide_lot: Select KPIs to move them, change their entry level, make them optional, or remove them all at once.
referentiels.contenu.aide_ouvrir: Click a KPI to open its sheet, or click the name of a theme to rename it.
referentiels.catalogue.ajouter_ligne_ari: Add a KPI above or below {code}
referentiels.bibliotheque.titre: Library: add a ready-made set of KPIs
referentiels.bibliotheque.aide: Each set brings its KPIs, themes, units and formulas. A KPI that you already have is reused: it is entered only once.
referentiels.bibliotheque.propre_aide: For a dashboard, a report or an internal request. Three ways to build it:
referentiels.calcul.sources_menu: Calculated with {n} KPIs: see the list
referentiels.calcul.utilisations_menu: Used to calculate {n} KPIs: see the list
referentiels.choisir.principe: Tick the KPIs to take. No KPI is copied: its value is entered only once and is used in all frameworks. The themes of origin are kept; you reorganise them at the next step.
referentiels.choisir.aucune_source: No other framework contains KPIs yet.
referentiels.choisir.voir_bibliotheque: Install a set from the library
referentiels.choisir.depuis_bibliotheque: Or install a set from the library
referentiels.choisir.cocher_un: Tick at least one KPI to add.

referentiels.choisir.ajoutes.one: {n} KPI added to “{referentiel}”. Put it in your themes, then assign it.
referentiels.choisir.ajoutes.other: {n} KPIs added to “{referentiel}”. Put them in your themes, then assign them.

referentiels.creation.suite_ranger: Here: put the KPIs in your themes (drag them, or tick them then “Arrange”).
referentiels.creation.suite_attribuer_ai: who enters what, for which organisation
referentiels.bibliotheque.voie_cocher_ai: Give it a name, then tick the KPIs to take from your frameworks. The simplest way.
referentiels.bibliotheque.voie_excel_aid: Download the template, describe your themes and your KPIs in Excel, then import it. A preview shows everything before saving.
referentiels.bibliotheque.voie_vide_aide: An empty framework: you create its themes and its KPIs one by one.
referentiels.reglable.colonnes_exemple:
pollutant ; Pollutant ; list ; POLLUTANTS
air ; Emissions to air ; number ; kg
referentiels.reglable.colonnes_aide: Table only: one column per line, “code ; name ; type ; list or unit”. Type: nombre (number), texte (text) or liste (list: give the code of a list of choices).
referentiels.reglable.reponse.tableau_te: One row per item, a number of rows that varies (pollutants, waste codes, subsidiaries). Describe its columns in “Columns (table)”: number, text, or a list of choices. Enters no calculation.
referentiels.reglable.reponse.tableau_ex: For example: emissions per pollutant, in kg.
referentiels.depuis.indisponible: {libelle} – not possible: closed period or existing values
referentiels.depuis.etat.clos: From {periode} (closed: added when you reopen it)
referentiels.depuis.choix_inconnu: Choose a period of this framework.
referentiels.depuis.refus_clos: {code} cannot leave {periode}: this period is closed. Reopen it first.
referentiels.depuis.refus_valeurs: {code} cannot leave {periode}: it has values there (entered or imported, N/A, comment, or evidence).
referentiels.depuis.avertissement_source: Warning: {calcule} is requested {depuis_calcule}, but its source {source} only {depuis_source}. {source} gets cells {depuis_calcule} to calculate {calcule}.

referentiels.depuis.effet.entre.one: {periode}: {n} KPI added now (cells to fill in: {cases}).
referentiels.depuis.effet.entre.other: {periode}: {n} KPIs added now (cells to fill in: {cases}).

referentiels.depuis.effet.reouverture.one: {periode} (closed): {n} KPI added when you reopen it (cells: {cases}); nothing changes while it is closed.
referentiels.depuis.effet.reouverture.other: {periode} (closed): {n} KPIs added when you reopen it (cells: {cases}); nothing changes while it is closed.

referentiels.contenu.lot.depuis_aria: Period from which the selected KPIs are requested
referentiels.contenu.aide_depuis: “Requested since”: the first period in which this framework requests the KPI. Select one or more KPIs, choose the period, then select Apply. A closed year does not change until you reopen it.
referentiels.choisir.depuis: Add them to previous years too?
referentiels.depuis.aide: By default, from the current period: no past year changes. A closed year gets the KPI when you reopen it. You can change it later in the framework content.
referentiels.apercu.depuis: KPIs new to this framework are requested
referentiels.depuis.fichier_confirmer: {code}: this date removes cells (empty) from a period in progress. Change it in the framework content, where you confirm it.
referentiels.mep.depart.aide: Do you have a backup of the tool, from another server or another computer? Restore it now. It replaces what you set in this wizard. You keep your account and your password.
referentiels.mep.depart.compte_d_abord: Do you have a backup of the tool? Create your account first. The next step lets you start from the backup.
